page.notes: Nicæna Synodus and the following text is printed partly in italic; Greek phrases transcribed as best legible. The final word of the page continues "rimo-" on the next page (catchword-like "rimo-" at the foot right). Some marginal letters are doubtful; the Greek of the note at "a" and the Greek "ἡ κατὰ τὸν κανόνα" may be misread. The printed word "duobusistis" is read as "duobusistis" (possibly "duobus illis").
